newRoom.title: New room
newRoom.intro: Bring a few bots together in one conversation.
newRoom.selectionHint: Select 2 to 6 distinct bots. Hidden bots are not shown.
newRoom.noBots: No visible bots can join a room.
newRoom.offline: Hermes is disconnected. Reconnect it, then create the room.
newRoom.createFailed: The room could not be created. Try again.
newRoom.duplicateHandles: These bots do not have unique @handles. Rename one bot before creating the room.
newRoom.turnNote: Creating a room itself starts no model turn. Bots run only after you send the first message.
